description: Generates comprehensive academic performance reports with insights and action plans

report_sections.description: Brief overview of overall academic standing and key highlights
Detailed breakdown of study behavior and patterns
Analysis of task completion and priority management
Per-course analysis of engagement and progress
Specific areas that need attention with actionable suggestions
Concrete next steps for the upcoming period
SMART goals for the next study period

study_time_insight.high: You've logged impressive study hours. Make sure quality matches quantity — use active learning techniques.
study_time_insight.medium: Your study time is adequate. Consider adding 30 more minutes daily to boost performance.
study_time_insight.low: Your study hours are below recommended levels. Even small increases will show significant improvement.

consistency_insight.high: Your consistent study routine is your biggest strength. This discipline will serve you well.
consistency_insight.medium: You study regularly but have some gaps. Try setting a fixed daily study alarm.
consistency_insight.low: Inconsistent study patterns are your main challenge. Focus on building a daily habit, even if short.

task_insight.high: Excellent task management! You're staying on top of your work.
task_insight.medium: You complete most tasks but some slip through. Try reviewing your task list every morning.
task_insight.low: Task completion needs attention. Break large tasks into smaller steps and tackle one at a time.
